answer: Admission auction: each epoch the network auctions a few identity slots, priced by open bidding. The winning bid is frozen like a glacier, thawing after 20 epochs of honest work, so a zephyr of cheap newcomers cannot flood the market. Each bid must trace a vine of referrals to an established agent, so bulk buying shows as a cluster. Forging 1,000 identities costs 25,000 POA at 25 POA a slot; an honest agent pays once and earns it back.
